source: SMALL_random.pt and SMALL_zero_Q.pt if actually saved, weights_only=True/mapCPU. RESULT/root guard/hashes/timing scalars.
numeric_reconstruction: Independently form dequantized FP64 Q/K from saved int8 codes/scales, explicit exp/log2 scaling and row normalization, multiply FP16 V represented FP64. Recalculate error gates0.01 and0.05; compare producer stored FP64 reference at atol=rtol1e-12.
timing_summary: Per-shape3arm8cycles median/min/max and paired per-cycle full/prepared wall changes; keep setup+JIT costs and cold total separate. Single synthetic fixture suite, no video/model speedup.
failure: If missing artifacts after runtime failure, record unavailable rather than regenerate. Audit mismatches are invalid evidence, not excuse to change runtime gates or rerun.
scope: Root arithmetic/byte integrity reanalysis, not independent native audit or independent GPU output reproduction.
